purpose: Test, on fresh post-C-4/post-A-28 simulations, (1) whether the assumed MSM observed-AIDS proxy can be reproduced jointly with MSM and early ECDC HIV diagnoses, and (2) how the user-approved predictive variance contract s(x)+s(x)/K behaves: heterogeneity of s(x) across the design and how many NROY decisions depend on the sampling error of s(x).

decisions_recorded.variance_contract: User decision 2026-09-16: predictive V_ensemble(x) = s(x) + s(x)/K; s(x) re-estimated at each design point from its K replicates; A-5 file not used.
decisions_recorded.aids_compartment: Checked 2026-09-16: chronic_to_aids sourced to CASCADE (2000, 2003); both define AIDS by the clinical part of the 1993 CDC definition, excluding CD4<200 without an AIDS-defining illness. No clinical-recognition fraction.
decisions_recorded.scope: User decision 2026-09-16: score RIVM MSM AIDS only; non-MSM AIDS reserved for validation; no presentation layer built.

limitations: New sequence, wave 1 over the full prior box. Not a continuation: the register, variance contract and extractor changed, and earlier NROY regions were defined under the construct-mismatched ECDC AIDS target.
The observed-AIDS proxy is an ASSUMPTION (aids_observation.OBSERVED_AIDS_PROXY): no reporting delay, notification completeness or clinical-recognition lag is modelled.
RIVM MSM route is mapped to the model MSM group, which includes trans people; RIVM's route classification of trans people is unverified.
V_obs is zero (underivable) for every scored target; this biases towards over-exclusion.
The primary discrepancy rule (10% of target, one sigma) follows the 2026-09-15 construct/variance audit recommendation; it is a declared assumption, not an estimate, and was not chosen from results.
s(x) from K=10 replicates carries chi-square sampling error (9 df); its effect on NROY membership is reported, not corrected.
400 points in 32 dimensions is a sparse space-filling design; an empty NROY set is a result about this design and budget, not proof that no parameter vector fits.
No output may be called a posterior, credible interval or final calibration ensemble.

rationale.min_nroy_members: Fewer than 10 survivors requires review before any continuation.

discrepancy.rationale: Prespecified target-scale discrepancy recommended by the 2026-09-15 audit, because the output-variance rule makes tolerance depend on the sampled design.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: target_relative_20pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: Prespecified wider target-relative allowance; diagnostic only.

sensitivity_discrepancies.label: output_variance_10pct
sensitivity_discrepancies.rationale: Legacy Andrianakis rule for comparability with the 2026-09-15 waves; diagnostic only.

scored_years_rationale: Keeps the 13 non-AIDS anchors of the 2026-09-15 waves. RIVM MSM AIDS anchors are five-yearly from 1990, plus 2019 (shared with SHM) and 2022 (last complete year); 2016 is held by the source policy.

waves.comment: Full prior box. Cross-validation: RIVM non-MSM and total AIDS, ECDC AIDS, UNAIDS and SHM total series.

run_settings.note: Fresh CRN seeds 92000-92009 shared by every point. V_ensemble(x) = s(x)(1 + 1/10) per point and target.
